HWSD v2.0 units and aggregation

tidyhwsd authors

2026-02-04

Source: vignettes/units-and-aggregation.Rmd
units-and-aggregation.Rmd

Data model (from the HWSD v2.0 manual)

HWSD v2.0 stores soil information per soil mapping unit (SMU). Each SMU can have up to 12 components, with:

  • SEQUENCE: order of components (sequence 1 is dominant)
  • SHARE: percent share, summed to 100 within an SMU
  • LAYER: D1 to D7 depth layers

hwsd2_layers is the component table; hwsd_extract() and hwsd_compose() map SMU IDs to attributes using these fields.

Units and codes

hwsd_props() provides a description and default aggregation rule for each property, plus a precision field that encodes the rounding step used after aggregation.

Common units (from the manual and field definitions):

  • Depth: TOPDEP, BOTDEP in cm (D1 = 0-20 cm; …; D7 = 150-200 cm)
  • Texture: SAND, SILT, CLAY in percent by weight
  • Bulk density: BULK, REF_BULK in g/cm3
  • Organic carbon: ORG_CARBON in percent by weight
  • pH: PH_WATER in water (-log(H+))
  • Total nitrogen: TOTAL_N in g/kg
  • CEC / ECEC / TEB: cmol/kg
  • Electrical conductivity: ELEC_COND in dS/m
  • AWC: AWC in mm/m (see manual table on USDA texture classes)

Code fields:

  • ROOT_DEPTH is a class code (1-4; deep to very shallow)
  • ROOTS, IL, SWR are class codes (see manual)
  • DRAINAGE is a categorical class

Aggregation behavior

hwsd_extract() returns dominant component values:

  • SEQUENCE = 1 is preferred
  • within SEQUENCE = 1, the largest SHARE is chosen
  • if no SEQUENCE = 1 exists, the largest SHARE is chosen

hwsd_compose() performs share-weighted synthesis using rules from hwsd_props():

  • numeric fields: weighted_mean
  • categorical fields: weighted_mode
  • ID-like fields: drop
  • numeric outputs are rounded to the precision step

Example:

props <- hwsd_props()
props$agg[props$property == "PH_WATER"] <- "dominant"

pt_dom <- hwsd_extract(
  coords = c(110, 40),
  param = c("PH_WATER", "SAND"),
  layer = "D1",
  ws_path = "D:/data/HWSD2"
)

pt_syn <- hwsd_compose(
  coords = c(110, 40),
  param = c("PH_WATER", "SAND"),
  layer = "D1",
  ws_path = "D:/data/HWSD2",
  props = props
)
